ModMetaData.name: Dawn of a New Day
ModMetaData.author: AlenDio
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a customizable header overlay that displays at the start of the day.
Features: - Customizable position offset, scale, line width, thickness and padding. - Adjustable display, fade-in, and fade-out durations. - Customizable text and outline of each day and date (Color, Font Size, Font Style, Outline Thickness). - Customazible text for "DAY" and "YEAR" allowing diverse lanugages or designs. - Can be shown every X days if wanted. - In-game settings preview button.
Can be safely added or removed from existing saves at any time.
